ai.title: Receipt recognition
ai.intro: A neural network from the chosen provider reads the receipt photo. Use the server key if the administrator set one up, or your own API key: then you pay for the requests and set the limits here.
ai.server_hint: {} · {} · up to {} receipts a day and {} a month
ai.keys_hint: The key is stored encrypted on the server and is never shown again: only the last 4 characters are visible. It is used only for your receipts.
ai.own_disabled: The server administrator has disabled personal keys.
ai.delete_confirm: Delete the {} key? Recognition with it will stop working.
ai.hint_anthropic: A key from the Anthropic Console (starts with sk-ant-). A Claude Pro subscription does not include API access: it is billed separately.
ai.hint_openai: A key from platform.openai.com (starts with sk-). A ChatGPT Plus subscription does not include API access: the API needs its own balance. Requests are sent with storage turned off (store: false).
ai.hint_gemini: A key from Google AI Studio. With a free key Google may use requests to improve its products; with billing enabled it does not.
ai.limits_hint: How many receipts can be recognised. With the server key its limits apply too and cannot be exceeded. Leave a field empty for the default.
